tools.machine: linux x64, 4 x Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz
tools.brotli: Node v22.22.2 zlib brotli, quality 11, window 24 bits, size hint set (no brotli program on PATH)

bundlers.esbuild: bundle, splitting, format esm, platform browser, target es2022, minify
bundlers.vite: vite build (production mode, its default minifier), one HTML page per app as input, target es2022; production build only, dev-mode dependency pre-bundling is out of scope
bundlers.webpack: mode production (its default terser minifier), target web and es2022, ES module output (experiments.outputModule)

method.sizes: raw: the file's bytes; gzip: the gzip program at -9 -n; brotli: see tools.brotli. Totals add every JavaScript file the bundler wrote.

browser.cache: cold: a new browser context and the cache disabled on every run
